articles.title: Bitcoin’s bull-bear cycle indicator turns green for first time since March 2023
articles.snippet: While some experts point to $90,000 as the next explosive level, others caution that this new "early bull" signal isn't a guaranteed crystal ball.

articles.title: Bitcoin will 'explode' past $90,000 and hit $126,000, Arthur Hayes says
articles.snippet: Arthur Hayes, the BitMEX co-founder who now runs Maelstrom, said bitcoin's return to its October high is a "foregone conclusion," and he is taking his fund to maximum risk, with HYPE, ZEC, and NEAR as his top altcoin picks.

articles.title: Ethereum derivatives unfazed by DeFi hacks: Can ETH hit $2.6K next?
articles.snippet: ETH futures and options signal quiet confidence among pros despite macro headwinds and DeFi exploits, keeping the $2,600 price target in play.

articles.title: Morning Minute: Circle Stock Soars After Q1 Beat, $222M Arc Raise
articles.snippet: Circle just beat earnings and raised fresh capital for its new Arc blockchain, while Michael Saylor explained how and why he'd sell Bitcoin.

articles.title: Hackers Used AI to Build a Zero-Day Exploit That Bypasses Two-Factor Authentication: Google
articles.snippet: Cybercriminals used an AI model to find and weaponize a previously unknown software flaw, Google's threat team confirmed Monday.
